item.title: Can Tho 2 Bridge investment policy approved
item.description: The bridge and its access roads will cost VND27 trillion.
item.content:encoded:
Deputy Minister of Construction Pham Minh Ha has signed a decision approving the investment policy for Can Tho 2 Bridge.

The project has a total investment of over VND27 trillion and will be implemented from 2026 to 2030.
